facts.value: On every animation update it first calls ftCo_800C4F64. If the HammerLanding countdown is already zero or negative, it also calls ftCo_800C4ED8. It then decrements the countdown, so a positive value delays that conditional handling until a later update.
facts.rationale: The ordering of the unconditional call, pre-decrement comparison, conditional call, and decrement defines the callback's timer guard exactly; because the comparison precedes the decrement, a value of zero triggers the conditional handler on that update.
